claims: 2026 NCAA Tournament first-round matchup occurred on March 20
Ja'Kobi Gillespie led Tennessee with 29 points and six 3-pointers
Peter Suder led Miami (Ohio) with 27 points
Game location was Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania
Tennessee advances to the second round to play 3-seed Virginia on March 22
Ethan Burg made a buzzer-beating 3-pointer at halftime
J.P. Estrella had 14 points and 10 rebounds for Tennessee
Miami (Ohio) scored 24 points in the second half
Tennessee's defense limited Miami (Ohio) to their lowest-scoring output of the season
